key_impacts: Harbor walls overtopped and shoreline flooding extended into city streets
Damage to public docks and cottages reported
Water intake pumps impacted by large water-level change
Up to 0.5 m water-level fluctuations recorded at Ludington harbor gauge
~2 m water-level fluctuations reported along coastline just outside the harbor
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor walls were overtopped; shoreline homes and boat docks were damaged; water intake pumps were impacted.
The Ludington harbor gauge recorded up to 0.5 m; 2 m fluctuations were reported just outside the harbor.
missing_information: Number of damaged structures not stated
